title: Why English councils refuse planning permission: decisions and refusal reasons by council and kind of work
description:
Counts of planning decisions and of the reasons councils gave for refusing them, by council and kind of work, for English local planning authorities. Counted by Plan Forecast (planforecast.co.uk) from the decisions and decision notices councils publish on their own planning registers.

Two CSV files: refusal reasons by council, kind of work and topic; and decisions and grant rates by council and kind of work. Counts only: no application reference, address, postcode, proposal text, council wording or person's name.

The latest figures are at planforecast.co.uk/data.
